topics: Test on stress-strain characteristics of mild steel and Tor Steel by conducting uniaxial tension test on rod specimens
Shear test on mild steel rod (Compression Testing Machine and Shear Shackle)
Flexural behaviour of steel by conducting a bending test on Rolled steel sections (I cross section)
Torsional behaviour and estimation of modulus of rigidity of steel by conducting torsion test on rod specimens
Estimation of modulus of rigidity of steel and brass / copper materials utilizing the principles of torsional vibrations – Torsion Pendulum.
Estimation of toughness of steel specimens by conducting (a) Izod & (b) Charpy impact tests.
Estimation of hardness properties of engineering materials such as brass, aluminium, copper, steel etc.by performing Brinell hardness test
Estimation of Hardness properties of engineering materials such as brass, aluminium, copper, steel etc.by performing (a) Rockwell hardness test (b) Vicker’s hardness test
Estimation of modulus of rigidity of steel by performing tension and compression tests on spring specimens.
Flexural behaviour of timber material by performing bending tests on beam specimens.
Estimation of compressive strength of timber specimen.
Experiment on verification of Maxwell’s reciprocal theorem
Study/demonstration of Strain Gauges and load cells
Bend & Rebend test on M S Rods
Tensile behaviour of polymeric membranes, textiles, fibres etc.
Digital Image Correlation Techniques for the study of material behaviour under various loading conditions

partB.description: Conduct of experiment/ Execution of work/ troubleshooting/ Programming

courseOutcomes.description: Identify the behaviour of engineering materials under various forms and stages of loading
Characterize the elastic properties of various materials.
Evaluate the strength and stiffness properties of engineering materials under various loading conditions
